_comment: Labelled fixtures for measuring detector precision and recall.
Ground truth is what a careful human would mark, not what the detectors in
this package happen to find. Several documents are labelled with entities no
detector here can reach -- a surname standing alone, a given name outside the
gazetteer -- because a corpus that only contains what the code already handles
measures nothing. The recall floors in eval_test.go are set below 1.0 for
exactly that reason, and the gap is the honest statement of what this package
Documents with an empty entity list are negatives: text that looks like it
contains an entity and does not. They are the only thing that makes the
Every value here is fabricated. Card numbers are the publicly published test
numbers that satisfy Luhn; IBANs satisfy mod-97; the DNI check letters are
correct. Nothing in this file identifies a person.
